why_D2_matters: D2 closes the two open questions from D1 with favorable results. (1) Funding history: 89.3d median is +0.83% APR, NEUTRAL regime. Not strongly favorable to shorts, but the trailing 90d is positive on average. (2) Dynamic-delta simulation: switching from a static range to a rebalance-aware model with 5 rebalance rules turns the model from marginal (D1) to robust (D2). 16 cells positive at median funding, 16 cells at p5 stress. The edge is real, not funding-dependent, and the next stages (D3 reward, D4 paper) are the right next steps before any execution.
